name: Invaders Slay Sleeping Soldiers in the Corridors
description: Under the cover of night, the invaders move swiftly through the corridors. They come upon the King's soldiers, who lie asleep and unaware. Drawing their swords, the invaders cut down the defenseless guards one by one, the blades flashing in the dim light. The corridors grow silent, save for the echoes of the attackers' footsteps.
related_events: Invaders attack sleeping soldiers in the corridors

name: Snow White and William Enter the Castle
description: Snow White and William run swiftly through the cloisters, passing the solitary apple tree, and rush into the castle.
related_events: Snow White and William dash past the apple tree into the castle

name: Snow White Wades Through the Foul Mire
description: Snow White splashes through the deep, stinking sludge, her movements slow and labored as she pushes forward through the thick, foul-smelling mire.
related_events: Snow White wades through deep stinking sludge

name: Snow White Prepares the Fire
description: Snow White shaves thin pieces of wood, her hands moving with practiced precision. She stacks the shavings neatly with other kindling and crouches close, blowing gently until the pile catches a spark and flames begin to rise.
related_events: Snow White shaves wood for a fire

name: Snow White Flees Riders Along the Shoreline
description: Snow White runs along the shoreline, her feet kicking up spray as waves lap the beach. Behind her, riders thunder on horseback, hooves pounding through the surf, closing the distance with each stride. She veers sharply around a rocky outcrop, darting between tide pools, while the riders fan out, urging their horses forward in pursuit.
related_events: Riders pursue Snow White along the shoreline

name: Snow White Identifies the New Prisoner
description: A guard opens the cell door and throws a prisoner inside, then slams the door shut and walks away. Snow White hears the footsteps and the clatter of the door, then watches from the shadows. She sees a figure on the floor but cannot make out who it is. She calls out, 'Rose?...' and peers into the darkness, trying to recognize the newcomer.
related_events: Snow White attempts to identify the newcomer in the dark cell
Guard throws prisoner into Greta's cell

name: Snow White Flees Amid Chaos
description: Panic spreads through the area as couriers and soldiers run in all directions, shouting and scrambling to escape. Snow White stands for a moment, disoriented by the sudden commotion. Then, without hesitation, she begins to run alongside the others, moving quickly through the turmoil.
related_events: Snow White runs away in confusion
Couriers and soldiers flee in panic

name: Snow White and William Carry the Injured Bird to the Castle
description: Snow White runs swiftly through a seaside village, cradling an injured bird in her hands. William follows close behind. They pass thatched cottages with flower gardens, where farmers and village maidens go about their day. The children race down sunlit dunes, the waves crashing beside them, the sand glowing underfoot. Ahead, the castle rises against the bright sky as they press forward, moving fast across the sand.
related_events: Snow White and William rush to the seaside village with an injured bird
Snow White and William sprint across sunlit dunes toward the castle

name: Snow White's Struggle to the Surface
description: Snow White is swept from the sewers into the sea. Seaweed wraps around her limbs, pulling her down into the depths. She kicks and fights, breaking free and swimming upward until she reaches the surface, where she gasps for air.
related_events: Snow White is swept from sewers into the sea
Seaweed entangles Snow White underwater
Snow White struggles to surface and gasps for air

name: King Magnus Receives His Newborn Daughter
description: After the birth of Snow White, the Queen gently places the newborn in the arms of King Magnus. The infant cries as the King cradles her, holding her close before turning to face a mirror in the chamber.
related_events: Queen gives newborn Snow White to King Magnus
King Magnus cradles infant Snow White before a mirror
related_occasions: Birth Ceremony Of Snow White

name: Snow White Enters the Dark Forest
description: Snow White reaches the top of a hill and pulls her mare to a halt as the animal rears, sensing the dread of the Dark Forest ahead. A thick mist rises from the trees, shrouding the entrance in shadow. Behind her, the sound of approaching riders grows louder. She turns the mare and spurs it forward, vanishing into the trees.
related_events: Snow White's mare rears at the edge of the Dark Forest
Snow White observes riders closing in and enters the Dark Forest

name: Snow White Bound in the Dark Forest
description: Snow White lies on the forest floor, her body entwined with thick vines and roots that coil around her wrists and ankles. Her eyes snap open, wide with shock, as she feels the restraint. She jerks her arms and legs, straining against the bindings, pulling until the vines tighten. Above, the canopy swallows the sky as the view rises, revealing the endless tangle of trees and shadow stretching in every direction.
related_events: Snow White awakens bound in the Dark Forest
Snow White struggles to free herself from plant bindings
Camera pulls up to reveal the expanse of the Dark Forest

name: Snow White Investigates the Bell and Cries
description: Snow White lies asleep when a bell begins to ring. At first, she thinks it is part of a dream, but then she hears cries of alarm. She sits up in bed, alert, and climbs out to see what is happening.
related_events: Snow White hears a bell ringing while lying asleep
Snow White hears cries of alarm
Snow White sits up in bed
Snow White climbs out of bed

name: Thomas Witnesses the Princess's Escape and Pursuit
description: Thomas, with his son's body draped over a mule, hears shouts from the guards. 'Open the gates!' they cry. He turns and sees the heavy gates swing open as armed riders surge out, galloping into the night. He stands still, watching the commotion unfold behind him.
related_events: Guards yell to open the gates after the Princess escapes
Riders gallop out through the opened gates in pursuit
Thomas looks back upon hearing the guards' shouts

name: Snow White Discovers Her Father's Death and Flees from Ravenna
description: Snow White rushed into her father's chamber and hurried down the corridor toward Ravenna, her stepmother, relief washing over her. But as she approached, her eyes fell upon her father's lifeless body lying still on the bed. Ravenna stood at the end of the room, flanked by Finn and a group of knights. Snow White froze, tears welling in her eyes as the truth became clear. Without a word, she turned and ran from the chamber, fleeing down the hall as the weight of the betrayal settled upon her.
related_events: Snow White discovers her father's death
Ravenna reveals betrayal with Finn and the knights
Snow White flees from the chamber in shock

name: Ravenna Greets Finn at the Castle Courtyard
description: Ravenna steps out of the castle carrying a lantern and walks across the courtyard. A portcullis rises, and dark figures emerge from the shadows, entering the castle. At their head is a tall warrior with pale eyes. Ravenna looks to him and says, 'Welcome, brother.'
related_events: Ravenna exits the castle and crosses the courtyard with a lantern
Dark figures emerge from the shadows and enter the castle
Finn leads the dark figures into the castle
Ravenna greets Finn as her brother

name: Snow White Flees from Armed Guards into a Tower
description: Snow White runs down the steps into a corridor and sees armed guards at the far end. She turns and hurries into another tower, slamming the door shut behind her and bolting it. Without pausing, she charges down the steps inside the tower.
related_events: Snow White runs down the steps into a corridor
Armed guards appear at the end of the corridor
Snow White hurries into another tower
Snow White bolts the door shut behind her
Snow White charges down the steps in the tower

name: Snow White Confronts Ravenna in the Tower Cell
description: Snow White lies asleep in a darkened cell in the north tower. Ravenna stands just outside, motionless, watching her. After some time, Snow White opens her eyes and sees Ravenna staring. Their gazes meet. Snow White asks, 'Why?' Ravenna does not respond. She turns and walks away, leaving Snow White alone in the cell.
related_events: Ravenna silently observes Snow White in the north tower cell
Snow White awakens and locks eyes with Ravenna
Ravenna ignores Snow White's question and departs

name: Finn Watches His Sister in Secret
description: From a concealed spot around the corner, Finn observes his sister without making his presence known. She remains unaware of his gaze, focused elsewhere, while nearby the silent tension between Snow White and Ravenna unfolds in the dim light of the cell.
related_events: Finn secretly watches his sister unnoticed

name: Snow White Escapes to the Sewers
description: Snow White bursts into the courtyard, gasping at the open air and sky. She runs toward the portcullis as magpies swoop down, fluttering in her face before flying off. She follows them, sliding on her hip through a narrow opening at the base of the castle wall and disappearing into the darkness below. The guards chase after her but cannot fit through the small passage, turning instead toward the portcullis.
related_events: Snow White runs through the courtyard toward the portcullis
Magpies fly into Snow White's face and signal her to follow
Snow White slides and enters the sewer through a small opening

name: Guards Abandon Sewer Chase, Head for Portcullis
description: The guards reach the small opening at the base of the castle wall but cannot fit through it. Seeing Snow White has disappeared into the darkness below, they turn and run toward the portcullis in pursuit.
related_events: Guards attempt to pursue Snow White but cannot fit through the opening
Guards run toward the portcullis to continue pursuit

name: Snow White Brings a Wounded Magpie to the Queen
description: Snow White rushes into her parents' chamber, holding a wounded magpie she found in the woods. The King and Queen turn from the window, and the Queen gently takes the bird from her. She pulls a ribbon from Snow White's hair and uses it to bind the magpie's wing. The bird flutters weakly at first, then gradually calms under her care. Snow White watches the bird intently, and the King observes her with a quiet sadness he hides behind a faint smile. The Queen, her voice soft, tells Snow White the bird will heal. She touches Snow White's heart and tells her she possesses a rare beauty that will help her become Queen one day. William stands in the doorway, watching the scene without speaking, his eyes lingering on the Queen's pale and fragile appearance.
related_events: Snow White brings wounded magpie to parents' chamber
Queen binds magpie's wing with ribbon
Magpie calms after receiving care
King hides sorrow while observing Snow White
Queen affirms Snow White's inner beauty and future role as Queen
William observes Queen's frail condition

name: Snow White Arrives at the Ruined Village
description: Snow White rides toward the village, her eyes scanning the wreckage of cottages burned, collapsed, or boarded up. The ground is littered with debris, and the air is still. As she draws closer, a group of villagers—men, women, children, all gaunt and hollow-eyed—emerge from the shadows, shuffling toward her with outstretched hands. She pulls her horse to a halt, her breath catching as she takes in the ruin of the place and the condition of its people. For a moment, the villagers' faces hold only pleading, but something shifts—their eyes grow more urgent, their steps quicker. She turns her horse and rides hard away, the sound of hooves rising behind her as figures in dark uniforms break from the tree line and give chase.
related_events: Snow White rides toward the devastated village
Snow White observes the destruction and suffering of the villagers
Villagers approach Snow White with desperate hope

name: Snow White Flees Villagers and Queen's Men
description: Snow White rode toward the village, but found it in ruins—cottages burned or boarded up, the air heavy with despair. A group of villagers, gaunt and hollow-eyed, emerged and approached her. At first they seemed to welcome her, but as they drew closer, their desperation turned sharp, their faces hard with need. She pulled back on the reins, then spurred her horse into a gallop. Behind her, the villagers gave no chase, but as she glanced over her shoulder, she saw the Queen's soldiers riding hard in pursuit.
related_events: Snow White flees from the dangerously desperate villagers
Queen's men pursue Snow White

name: Finn Seeks a Guide for the Dark Forest
description: Finn approaches a group of villagers gathered by his men, announcing that the Queen requires someone to navigate the Dark Forest. The villagers remain silent, shaking their heads in refusal. An old lady speaks up, stating that no one goes into the Dark Forest. Finn offers compensation, but still no one volunteers. An old-timer steps forward, looks directly at Finn, and says there is one man—a widower—currently drinking at the inn. Finn asks where he might find him. Before the old-timer can answer, the sound of splintering wood cuts through the air. Everyone turns to see Eric burst through the inn's wall and crash to the ground in a heap.
related_events: Finn addresses villagers to recruit a navigator for the Dark Forest
Villagers refuse to volunteer for the Dark Forest mission
Old-timer identifies a potential navigator

name: Eric Crashes Through the Inn Wall
description: The group turns as the sound of splintering wood echoes through the air. Eric bursts through the inn's wall, sending debris flying, and lands in a crumpled heap on the ground outside.
related_events: Eric crashes through the inn's wall

name: Snow White Rescues the Wounded Magpie
description: A wounded magpie lies twitching in a puddle, its wings flapping wildly as William reaches toward it. He pulls back, startled, then says the bird is dying and shouldn't be touched. Snow White steps forward, kneels beside the bird, and gently strokes it. The flapping slows. She carefully picks it up. High in a tree, another magpie watches, still and silent.
related_events: Wounded magpie flaps wildly when approached
William hesitates and refuses to pick up the wounded magpie
Snow White calms and picks up the wounded magpie

name: The Magpie in the Tree
description: High in the branches of a tree, a magpie perches silently, watching as the two children approach the wounded bird lying in the puddle. It remains still, its eyes fixed on the scene below, as Snow White kneels down and reaches out to stroke the trembling magpie. The bird in the tree does not move or call out, but continues to observe as the girl gently lifts the injured creature from the ground.
related_events: Another magpie observes from a tree

name: Eric Awakens to a Scream and Takes Up Arms
description: Eric lies sprawled on the forest floor, motionless, an empty flagon of grog beside him. A woman's scream pierces the air, cutting through the trees. His eyes flicker, then begin to open. He stirs, groggy and unsteady, pushing himself to his feet. The wind whips through the woods as he grabs two throwing hatchets and slides them into the harness on his back.
related_events: Eric lies unconscious in the woods after heavy drinking
Eric regains consciousness after hearing a scream
Woman's scream echoes through the woods
Eric retrieves throwing hatches and prepares to respond

name: Sara's Spectral Vision Appears in the Woods
description: A sudden image of Sara materializes in the woods. She is pale and beautiful, her dress stained with blood that spreads across the fabric. Her mouth is open in a silent scream, her face twisted in pain. The vision flickers in the air, motionless and cold, then vanishes as quickly as it came.
related_events: Vision of Sara appears in distress

name: Snow White Reaches the Shore and Sees the Rocky Maze
description: Snow White swims to the shore and climbs onto the beach. She looks ahead and sees a maze of large rocks stretching out before her.
related_events: Snow White swims ashore and reaches the beach
Snow White sees a maze of large rocks ahead

name: Snow White Follows the Magpies
description: Snow White begins to move in one direction when the two magpies reappear, calling to her. She turns and scrambles after them, changing her path as she follows their lead.
related_events: Two magpies reappear and urge Snow White to follow
Snow White scrambles after the magpies

name: Snow White Rides the White Mare
description: Snow White sees a white mare lying on the beach. She approaches and climbs onto the mare. The mare rises and swiftly carries her away across the sand.
related_events: Snow White sees a white mare waiting on the beach
White mare allows Snow White to climb on and then departs rapidly

name: Ravenna Questions the Mirror and Learns of Snow White's Beauty
description: Ravenna stands before her mirror, asking who is the fairest in the land. The bronze surface ripples, and the Mirror Man emerges, telling her that she is no longer the most beautiful—Snow White now holds that title. He adds that Snow White is the reason Ravenna's powers are fading. Ravenna stumbles back in shock, then demands Snow White's name. When the Mirror Man speaks it, she becomes enraged, declaring that Snow White should have been killed as a child and vowing she will not live to see the next day. The Mirror Man then suggests that Snow White's heart, if taken, could grant Ravenna immortality. Ravenna laughs in delight at the prospect. Finn enters from the shadows, seeing only Ravenna laughing at her reflection, unaware of the figure who has just spoken to her.
related_events: Ravenna confronts the Magic Mirror about her beauty
Mirror Man reveals Snow White is more beautiful than Ravenna
Ravenna reacts with shock and vows to kill Snow White

name: The Mirror's Revelation
description: Ravenna stands before her mirror, her reflection restored and youthful. The bronze surface ripples, and the Mirror Man emerges, taking form before her. He tells her that Snow White has become more beautiful than she is, and that her powers are fading because of it. Ravenna demands to know the name, and when he speaks it—Snow White—she reels, remembering the girl she once spared. The Mirror Man adds that Snow White’s innocence and purity make her heart a source of true immortality. If Ravenna holds it in her hands, she will never age, weaken, or need to feed on the youth of others again. Ravenna laughs, overcome with delight at the promise of eternal life. From the shadows, Finn steps forward, seeing only his sister gazing into the mirror and laughing, unaware of the figure who has spoken to her.
related_events: Mirror Man reveals that Snow White's heart can grant immortality
Ravenna reacts with joy to the prospect of immortality

name: Finn Witnesses Ravenna's Mirror Revelation
description: Finn steps out from the shadows and sees Ravenna standing before her mirror, laughing with wild delight. She speaks to the mirror as if someone is answering her, but there is no one else in the room. Her joy is intense, almost feverish, as she gazes into the bronze surface. Finn watches in silence, unseen, as she revels in a secret only she knows.
related_events: Finn observes Ravenna laughing at her mirror in isolation

name: Snow White Hears Footsteps and Pretends to Sleep
description: Snow White hears approaching footsteps. She quickly jumps up and gets into her bed, closing her eyes and lying still. The door opens, a guard enters, and unlocks the cell across the hall. After a moment, the door clangs shut again. Once the guard is gone, Snow White sits up, walks to her cell door, and looks down the corridor at the opposite cell. She calls out softly. 'Hello?... What's your name?' A woman named Rose moves from the shadows, approaching her own cell bars to respond.
related_events: Snow White hears approaching footsteps
Snow White jumps up and pretends to sleep

name: Snow White Observes the New Prisoner
description: The fire burns as Snow White warms her hands. She hears approaching footsteps and quickly returns to her bed, pretending to sleep. A guard opens a cell opposite her, then a moment later, the door clangs shut. After the guard leaves, Snow White gets up, walks to her cell door, and looks down the hall at the newly occupied cell. She calls out, 'Hello?... What's your name?' A woman named Rose moves from the dark corner of her cell to the bars and looks out.
related_events: Guard opens cell opposite Snow White
Guard closes and secures cell door with a clang
Snow White rises and observes the hallway

name: Snow White and Rose Exchange Names
description: Snow White calls out to the person in the cell across from hers. A woman named Rose moves from the shadows to the bars of her cell and answers. Snow White smiles when she sees her.
related_events: Snow White calls out to the occupant of the opposite cell
Rose approaches cell bars and identifies herself
Snow White smiles upon seeing Rose's face

name: The Queen Pricks Her Finger on the Winter Rose
description: High above, the castle gardens lie covered in snow. A woman in a fur-lined cloak walks through the stillness. She pauses, drawn to a red rose blooming amid the frost. The Queen reaches for the flower. As her finger brushes the thorn, it pricks her skin. Three drops of blood fall, each landing on the white snow with a sharp, heavy impact. The crimson stains spread slowly against the white.
related_events: Queen admires falling snow and notices a blooming rose
Queen reaches for the rose and pricks her finger
Three drops of blood fall onto the snow

name: The Queen's Wish and the Touch of Her Hand
description: High above, the castle gardens lie covered in snow. Footsteps crunch as a woman in a fur-lined cloak walks toward a single red rose blooming in the frost. A raven watches from nearby. The Queen reaches for the flower and pricks her finger. Three drops of blood fall onto the white snow—one, then another, then a third, each landing with a heavy thud. She startles, then grows still. Her hand moves to her stomach, resting there in silence. A newborn’s cry pierces the air.
related_events: Queen wishes for a child with specific traits
Queen touches her stomach after being startled

name: The Birth of the Child with the Cry in the Snow
description: A piercing cry echoes through the castle gardens as a newborn baby is born. The sound cuts through the still winter air, following the moment the Queen touched her stomach after pricking her finger on a rose. Three drops of blood lie vividly against the snow, near the red bloom and the watching raven.
related_events: Newborn baby emits a piercing cry

name: Eric and the Slave Merchant Bargain for Rose
description: A rickety prison wagon filled with beautiful girls sits nearby, each staring out furiously from behind the bars. Rose, bound and gagged, stands among them, her expression fierce. Eric and a slave merchant argue over her price. The merchant inspects her, commenting that her nose is large and her chin weak, then offers two gold pieces. Eric reminds him of their past business. The merchant raises his offer to four gold pieces, but Eric begins to walk away. As he pulls Rose with him, the merchant calls out ten gold pieces. Eric hesitates, considers, then turns back with a smile. The two men complete the exchange.
related_events: Eric and slave merchant haggle over price of bound Rose

name: Slave Merchant Raises Offer, Eric Pauses
description: Eric turns away, leading Rose toward the rickety prison wagon as the slave merchant calls out, raising his offer to ten gold pieces. Eric stops in his tracks, stands still for a moment, then slowly turns back, a smile forming on his face.
related_events: Slave merchant increases offer to ten gold pieces to secure purchase of Rose
Eric hesitates before accepting slave merchant's offer for Rose

name: Eric Sells Rose to the Slave Merchant
description: Eric hesitates as the slave merchant calls out an offer of ten gold pieces. He turns back, smiles, and accepts the deal. Rose, bound and gagged, glares furiously as the transaction is completed.
related_events: Eric agrees to sell Rose to slave merchant for ten gold pieces

name: Prison Wagon Carries Bound Women
description: A rickety prison wagon rolls forward, carrying a group of women bound in chains. They stare out from behind the bars, their faces filled with fury. Among them is Rose, her expression as fierce as the others, her body restrained and mouth gagged as the wagon rumbles through the open.
related_events: Prison wagon carries group of furious women in chains

name: Rose Recognizes Snow White and Questions Her Survival
description: After mentioning Duke Hammond, Rose sees Snow White's face light with hope. Snow White asks urgently if the Duke still lives and fights in her father's name. Rose stares at her, suddenly realizing who she is. She asks if Snow White is the king's daughter, recalling that everyone in the castle was said to have been killed the night the evil one took power. She asks how Snow White could have survived. Snow White, breathless, shifts focus and demands to know about William, the Duke's son—whether he is alive. Rose shakes her head, saying she does not know, and continues to study Snow White as distant cries of other prisoners echo nearby. She whispers, 'What will they do to me?'
related_events: Snow White reacts with hope upon hearing Duke Hammond is alive
Rose realizes Snow White's true identity
Rose questions how Snow White survived the castle massacre

name: Rose and Snow White Exchange News of the Duke and His Son
description: Rose tells Snow White that she was trying to reach Duke Hammond's castle for safety after all the girls in her village were taken. When Snow White hears the Duke is still alive and fighting in her father's name, her face lights up with hope. She immediately asks Rose about William, the Duke's son, and whether he is alive. Rose looks at her steadily, then shakes her head, saying she does not know. In the distance, the cries of other female prisoners can be heard.
related_events: Rose recounts escape attempt to Duke Hammond's castle
Snow White urgently asks Rose about William's fate
Rose expresses uncertainty about William's fate

name: Rose Hears the Cries of Captive Women
description: After speaking with Snow White, Rose hears the distant cries of other female prisoners echoing through the air. The sound breaks the moment, and her expression tightens with fear. She looks around, then whispers, 'What will they do to me?'
related_events: Rose hears cries of other female prisoners
Rose voices fear about her own fate as a prisoner

name: Ravenna's Procession to the Altar
description: Ravenna walks down the center aisle in a stunning wedding dress. Nobles line both sides of the aisle, smiling and nodding politely. Their eyes, however, are fixed on Snow White, who follows behind Ravenna, gently holding the folds of the bride's silk train. Snow White looks up at Ravenna with adoration. The bride and groom continue forward and reach the altar, where King Magnus turns and smiles, appearing as the happiest man alive.
related_events: Ravenna walks down the center aisle at her wedding
Nobles display polite appreciation while focusing on Snow White
related_occasions: Ravenna'S Royal Wedding Ceremony

name: Snow White Holds Ravenna's Wedding Train
description: Ravenna walks down the center aisle in a stunning dress, followed by Snow White, who holds the folds of the silk wedding train. The nobles stand on either side, smiling and nodding, their eyes fixed ahead. Snow White looks up at Ravenna with quiet admiration. As they reach the altar, King Magnus turns and smiles, radiant and fulfilled.
related_events: Snow White holds the wedding dress train and looks at Ravenna adoringly
related_occasions: Ravenna'S Royal Wedding Ceremony

name: King Magnus Smiles at Ravenna at the Altar
description: Ravenna and the groom reach the altar. King Magnus turns to Ravenna and smiles, his expression filled with joy.
related_events: King Magnus smiles at Ravenna upon reaching the altar
related_occasions: Ravenna'S Royal Wedding Ceremony

name: Ravenna Confronts Finn After the Girl's Escape
description: Ravenna paces in tight, furious circles, her voice sharp and wild as she berates Finn, who stands motionless in the center of the room, blood streaking his face. She rages about a young girl who escaped with nothing but a nail, mocking how she bested her brother and nearly overtook the castle. Ravenna shouts that the girl is vital to her future, that there is no loyalty left, no one she can trust. She stops suddenly, marches to Finn, and strikes him hard across the face. He stumbles, then straightens, looking at her. He says the girl was chased into the dark forest and is likely dead. Ravenna screams, slapping him again. She demands the girl’s heart, declaring he has failed her. Finn snaps, shouting back that he has given her everything. Ravenna pauses, then softens. She touches his face, and his wound vanishes. His expression calms. She tells him not to fail her again, then adds quietly that she has no power in the Dark Forest — he must bring her someone who knows it well, someone who can hunt the girl down.
related_events: Ravenna confronts Finn about failing to protect her
Finn stands injured while being scolded by Ravenna

name: Ravenna Strikes Finn and He Fights Back
description: Ravenna stops her furious pacing, turns to Finn, and strikes him hard across the face. He staggers slightly, then straightens, blood still on his skin. In that moment, he erupts, shouting that he has given her everything. His voice is raw, defiant. Ravenna does not respond with anger. Instead, she grows still, then steps toward him, raises her finger, and gently touches his face. The wound closes instantly. Finn’s expression calms. He looks at her and says, 'Indeed, my Queen.' Ravenna warns him not to fail her again and demands someone who knows the Dark Forest, someone who can hunt the girl.
related_events: Ravenna strikes Finn forcefully after his failure
Finn protests his loyalty to Ravenna

name: Ravenna Heals Finn and Commands a Forest Guide
description: After Finn erupts in anger, Ravenna softens. She meets his outburst with quiet intensity, telling him she has given him everything. She raises her finger and touches his face; his wound closes instantly, and his expression calms. He nods. 'Indeed, my Queen,' he says. She warns him not to fail her again, then orders him to bring someone who knows the Dark Forest well—someone who can hunt the girl.
related_events: Ravenna asserts her reciprocal devotion to Finn
Ravenna heals Finn's wound with a touch
Ravenna demands a guide for the Dark Forest

name: Ravenna's War Council
description: Ravenna stands in a black gown, open at the front, as her generals and Finn face her. Maids attend her silently. The Black Knight General uses a pointer to address a map held by another general, reporting scattered rebel groups near the dark forest. Ravenna dips her fingers into a bowl of dead songbirds, plucks out a tiny heart, and eats it without expression. Another general speaks of rebel attacks on supply lines and the capture of two rebel leaders, who are to be executed. Ravenna interrupts, demanding the rebels be brought to her for interrogation. She drops her robe and ascends the steps to her bath, lowering herself into a white, viscous liquid. She emerges like a statue, now dressed, and stands at a window with Finn beside her. Below, a crowd of starving peasants fights over milk flowing from her bath. She watches, then asks Finn if he remembers their childhood, begging for scraps. He answers yes. She asks, 'Am I not kinder?'
related_events: Black Knight General reports rebel presence near dark forest
Ravenna listens to military report while eating a dead songbird's heart
Another General reports rebel attacks on supply lines
Generals announce capture of two rebel leaders
Ravenna orders siege and brutal tactics against the Duke's supporters
Ravenna demands personal interrogation of captured rebel leaders
related_occasions: Military Strategy Briefing With Ravenna And Her Generals

name: Ravenna's Bath and the Starving Below
description: After the generals leave, Ravenna drops her robe and steps into a bath filled with a thick, white liquid. She submerges completely, then rises slowly, her skin glistening. Dressed once more, she stands at a high window beside Finn. Below, a crowd of emaciated peasants scrambles for the milky fluid draining from the chamber. A maid presents a bowl of dead songbirds. Ravenna plucks a tiny heart from one and eats it. Her gaze lingers on the scene outside. 'Do you remember when we were children, begging for scraps like those wretches?' she asks. Finn answers, 'Yes, my Queen.' Ravenna is silent for a moment. 'Am I not kinder?'
related_events: Ravenna undresses and immerses herself in a mysterious white liquid bath
Ravenna eats a dead songbird's heart while standing at the window with Finn
Starving peasants fight over milk flowing from Ravenna's bath
Ravenna reflects on her past and questions her kindness compared to her childhood

name: Snow White Finds Rose Aged in the Cell
description: Snow White hurries down the steps to Greta's cell. She stops short upon seeing Rose, now an old woman, inside. Rose extends both hands toward her. Snow White reaches out, takes them, and looks into Rose's eyes.
related_events: Snow White rushes to Greta's cell
Snow White sees Rose transformed into an old woman
Rose reaches out to Snow White with both hands
Snow White takes Rose's hands and looks into her eyes

name: Snow White Flees After Failed Rescue
description: Snow White rushed down the steps to Greta's cell, shocked by what she saw. Rose, now an old woman, looked at her and urged her to go. Snow White fumbled with the keys, trying to unlock the cell, but then heard Finn stumbling toward the door, clutching his face. He shouted for the guards. Snow White tossed the keys into an empty cell and ran, disappearing down the corridor just as Finn reached the door.
related_events: Rose tells Snow White to go
Snow White fumbles with the cell keys

name: Finn Calls for the Guards
description: Finn, clutching his face, stumbles to the cell door. He shouts for the guards. Snow White throws the keys into an empty cell and runs down the corridor.

Finn calls for the guards

name: Snow White Triggers Hallucinogenic Pollen Release
description: Snow White trips over a root and falls face first into a patch of large mushrooms. The impact causes the mushrooms to release thick clouds of pollen into the air. The spores spread quickly, filling the surrounding forest with a dense, swirling haze.
related_events: Snow White trips over a root and lands in a patch of large mushrooms
Mushrooms release clouds of pollen into the air

name: Snow White's Hallucinogenic Vision
description: Snow White trips over a root and lands face first in a patch of large mushrooms that release thick clouds of pollen. She coughs and tries to fan the air, but soon the forest begins to change. The trees appear as hooded figures watching her through the fog. Eyeless owls stare from the branches, and black oil seeps from the trunks. A vine reaches down and brushes against her. She runs, breathless, as vampire bats shriek from the trees and skeletal forms crack out of the bark, closing in. Finally, she stumbles and collapses, unconscious.
related_events: Snow White inhales pollen and begins hallucinating
Snow White sees hooded tree figures and eyeless owls in hallucination

name: Snow White Flees Touching Vine and Screaming Bats
description: Snow White stumbles through the mist-shrouded forest, breath ragged as she runs. A hanging vine reaches down and brushes against her like a hand. She sees vampire bats shrieking from the trees, their wings flapping wildly in the thick air. Around her, the fog swirls, distorting shapes and sounds. She pushes forward, fleeing deeper into the woods, surrounded by visions that close in from all sides.
related_events: A hanging vine appears to touch Snow White like a hand
Snow White sees vampire bats screaming from the trees
Snow White runs from hallucinated terrors in the mist
Snow White attempts to flee the hallucinogenic forest

name: Snow White Faints as Skeletal Figures Attack
description: Huge skeletal forms crack out of the tree trunks and lunge toward Snow White. She stumbles, her breath ragged, eyes wide with terror as the figures close in. The air pulses with hallucinations, and her body gives way. She collapses to the ground, unconscious.
related_events: Huge skeletal forms emerge from tree bark and descend on Snow White
Snow White passes out from hallucinatory overload

name: Ravenna Destroys Artifacts and Summons the Mirror Man
description: Ravenna walks from statue to painting to urn, toppling and tearing them from the walls. Her soldiers enter, carrying a large object, and place it against the wall—a beautiful mirror. They leave, and Ravenna stands before it. She speaks: 'Mirror, mirror, on the wall. Who is the fairest of them all?' The mirror's surface ripples. Liquid spills onto the floor, rising and reforming into the figure of the Mirror Man. His body shimmers like reflective bronze, his face a distorted echo of Ravenna's own. He bows. 'It is you, my Queen! Yet another kingdom falls to your glory! Is there no end to your power and beauty?' Ravenna smiles, steps to the center of the room, raises her arms, and lets out a long, piercing scream.
related_events: Ravenna destroys artifacts in the room
Ravenna's soldiers deliver a large object
Ravenna performs a ritualistic scream of power
The Mirror Man emerges from the magical mirror

name: Ravenna Commands Execution and Captures Snow White
description: After seizing control, Ravenna stands at the top of the courtyard stairs, surrounded by guards. The wedding guests and nobles are held captive, their faces filled with fear. Ravenna scans the crowd and gives a single order: 'To the sword.' Gasps and screams erupt as the guards begin to move among the people. Off to the side, Finn tries to slip away, his dagger pressed to Snow White's neck. Ravenna sees them and calls out his name. He stops and turns. She looks at the girl, then issues a new command: Snow White is to be locked away. The guards take the girl as the executions proceed around them.
related_events: Ravenna orders execution of wedding guests
Ravenna identifies Finn holding Snow White hostage
Ravenna orders Snow White imprisoned

name: Ravenna's Capture and the Fall of the Gypsy Camp
description: The King's men launch a violent raid on a gypsy camp. Young Ravenna is ripped from her mother's arms as she screams. Finn rushes to help but is struck down by a guard's backhand and thrown to the ground. Ravenna's mother steps forward to fight, but the soldier holding Ravenna draws a dagger and presses it to the girl's throat, halting her. Ravenna is then dragged away and thrown onto the back of a horse. As she is carried off, she looks back to see her mother and the other gypsies cut down. Finn struggles to his feet and runs after the departing soldiers, chasing them across the land, but they ride on without stopping.
related_events: Young Ravenna is captured by the King's men
Finn is struck down while trying to rescue Ravenna
Ravenna's mother is threatened and killed
Ravenna is taken away on horseback
Finn chases the departing soldiers

name: Knights Battle Invaders in the Courtyard
description: Duke Hammond's knights clash with invading forces in the courtyard, fighting desperately to hold back the assault. Amid the chaos, Snow White emerges, disoriented by the violence, just as William breaks free from the guards and runs to her. Before they can reach safety, strong hands lift them onto separate horses. Duke Hammond and his guard charge toward the castle gates, managing to pass under the portcullis with William. As the bodyguard follows with Snow White, an arrow strikes him in the back. He falls, dragging Snow White down with him. The portcullis slams shut, leaving William trapped outside, shouting for his father and the princess. The last thing he sees is Finn grabbing Snow White and pulling her back into the castle.
related_events: Duke Hammond's knights struggle to repel invaders in the courtyard

name: Snow White and William's Escape Attempt
description: Snow White steps into the courtyard, stunned by the chaos of battle. William breaks away from the guards restraining him and runs to her. Before they can react, strong arms reach down, lifting Snow White and William onto separate horses. Duke Hammond and his men begin to ride out, fleeing the castle as the portcullis starts to lower.
related_events: Snow White witnesses the battle and reunites with William
William and Snow White are lifted onto separate horses

name: Escape Under the Portcullis
description: Duke Hammond and his personal guard mounted their horses and raced toward the castle gates as chaos filled the courtyard. Amid the clash of steel and shouts of battle, Duke Hammond and William spurred their horses forward, narrowly passing beneath the descending portcullis just before it crashed shut. Behind them, an arrow struck one of the guards in the back, knocking him from his horse and leaving Snow White stranded as the iron gate sealed the castle off.
related_events: Duke Hammond and his guard attempt to flee the castle on horseback
Duke Hammond and William ride under the closing portcullis

name: Finn's Arrow Halts the Escape
description: As Duke Hammond's bodyguard began to follow the Duke through the portcullis, an arrow fired by Finn struck him in the back. The force of the impact caused the bodyguard to lose control, and he fell from the horse, pulling Snow White down with him. Both crashed to the ground just outside the castle gates.
related_events: Finn's arrow strikes Duke Hammond's bodyguard in the back
Snow White and the bodyguard are thrown off the horse

name: William and Snow White Separated by the Closing Portcullis
description: Young William cried out as the portcullis slammed down, cutting him off from Snow White. On the other side, Snow White struggled in Finn's grip as he dragged her back toward the castle entrance. William reached toward her, but the heavy gate stood between them, immovable.

Snow White struggles in Finn's arms as he hauls her back into the castle

name: The Mare Stumbles in the Bog and Throws Snow White to Safety
description: The mare charges into the misty bog and suddenly loses her footing. She rears up, throwing Snow White onto the solid ground at the edge. Snow White lies there as the horse struggles in the mire, unable to regain her balance.
related_events: Mare charges into misty bog and loses footing
Snow White is thrown onto solid ground

name: Snow White reaches for the mare's reins as the horse pulls away
description: After landing on solid ground, Snow White reaches for the mare's reins. The horse resists, stepping back and moving deeper into the fog. Snow White tries again, but the mare continues to retreat, putting more distance between them as the mist swirls around them.

name: Snow White Flees as Riders Reappear
description: The silhouettes of the riders emerged in the fog. Snow White, standing alone and unable to reach her horse, turned and ran into the forest.
related_events: Silhouettes of riders reappear in the fog
Snow White flees into the forest

name: Horses Panic as Guard Is Swallowed by the Bog
description: The riders urge their horses forward to pursue Snow White, but the animals suddenly rear and kick in terror, refusing to advance. One guard is thrown from his mount as the horse bucks wildly. He lands in the bog and is quickly pulled under, vanishing into the mire. The other riders, seized by fear, turn their horses and retreat.
related_events: Riders' horses rear and kick in terror
Guard is thrown off horse and sucked down in bog

name: The Magpies Halt at the Forest's Edge
description: The magpies hover near the edge of the forest, their wings twitching with unease. They peer into the mist-shrouded trees but do not cross. Behind them, the riders' horses had reared in terror, one guard swallowed by the bog. The magpies remain in the open, watching the dark tree line. No sound comes from within. After a moment, they turn and fly away, leaving the forest undisturbed.
related_events: MAGPIES are too afraid to enter the forest

name: Ravenna's Wedding Preparation
description: Attendants surround Ravenna, carefully applying powder to her cheeks, shaping her eyebrows, and painting her lips as she sits motionless, her gaze fixed ahead. One handmaiden continues to weave delicate flowers into her hair while the others quietly step away. Snow White stands nearby, watching in silence. 'You're so beautiful,' she says softly. Ravenna turns, her expression shifting as she looks at the girl. She extends her arm and beckons, 'Come.' Snow White steps forward. Ravenna thanks her gently, then smiles and asks if she would like to be dressed like this and married one day. Snow White nods, and says she would be happy to invite Ravenna. The Queen grows thoughtful, recalling how she was taken from her mother as a girl, dressed in lace, and married to a King. She says she cannot replace Snow White's mother, but feels a bond between them. She touches her heart. Snow White hesitates, then touches her own heart in return and smiles. Ravenna watches her, briefly still, as the handmaiden finishes threading flowers into her hair.

name: Ravenna and Snow White Share a Moment Before the Wedding
description: Snow White whispered, 'You're so beautiful...' Ravenna, her face adorned with powder, paint, and carefully styled hair, turned her gaze toward the girl. Her expression softened. Without a word, she beckoned with a glance and extended her arm, inviting Snow White forward. The attendants stepped back, leaving only one handmaiden who continued weaving flowers into Ravenna's hair. Ravenna thanked Snow White gently, saying, 'That is kind, child. Especially when it is said that yours is the face of true beauty in this kingdom.' Snow White hesitated, then smiled shyly. Ravenna asked if she would like to be dressed up like this and married one day. Snow White nodded. 'I hope you'll invite me,' Ravenna said. 'Of course,' Snow White replied, her smile widening. Ravenna grew quiet, then said she knew it was difficult—when she was young, she had lost her mother, and a king had taken her, dressed her in lace, and stolen her innocence. Snow White looked up, surprised. Ravenna touched her heart, saying she could never replace Snow White's mother, but felt they were bound together. Snow White mirrored the gesture, touching her own heart, and smiled. Ravenna paused, studying the girl's face.

Ravenna expresses gratitude to Snow White for her compliment

Ravenna's expression grows thoughtful. She tells Snow White that when she was her age, she lost her mother, and a King took her away, dressed her in lace, and stole her innocence. She says she cannot replace Snow White's mother, but feels a bond between them, touching her heart. Snow White, after a pause, touches her own heart in return and smiles. Ravenna watches her, silent for a moment, as the girl's radiant expression lingers in the air.

name: William Teases Snow White with a Red and White Apple
description: In the cloister gardens, William climbs the branches of an apple tree with a small toy bow strapped to his back. He picks a distinctive red and white apple and holds it out to Snow White as if to give it to her. Just as she reaches for it, he pulls the apple away and takes a large bite, grinning. Snow White reacts by shoving him from the tree. They both fall to the ground. From the throne room balcony, King Magnus and Duke Hammond watch the scene unfold.
related_events: William picks a distinctive red and white apple from the tree
William teases Snow White with the apple
Snow White shoves William out of the apple tree

name: King Magnus and Duke Hammond Seal Alliance
description: From the throne room balcony, King Magnus watches his daughter Snow White and William, the son of Duke Hammond, playing in the apple tree below. William picks a distinctive red and white apple and offers it to Snow White, but pulls it away at the last moment and takes a bite himself, grinning. Snow White shoves him, and they both fall to the ground. Unseen by the children, the two men observe the scene. King Magnus tells Duke Hammond that his daughter will need William's friendship, and so will he. Duke Hammond bows his head and replies that they are there to serve, your Majesty.

name: Snow White and King Magnus Mourn the Queen's Death
description: After the harshest winter in memory, Snow White's mother passes away. The garden lies covered in snow, bare of the red rose that once bloomed. King Magnus walks with his arm around Snow White, who sheds a single tear. Onlookers and mourners in the palace grounds watch her face, their expressions mirroring her sorrow as they quietly move aside.

King Magnus comforts Snow White while mourning her mother's death
Snow White sheds a tear during her mother's mourning period

name: Dark Forces Gather at the Border
description: A year has passed since the death of Snow White's mother. King Magnus still grieves, his sorrow unrelenting. The kingdom feels the weight of his loss. In the silence of the snow-covered gardens, where no red rose blooms, the palace stands somber. From the throne room balcony, the King walks with his arm around Snow White, both cloaked in quiet mourning. Beyond the kingdom's borders, figures move through the shadows. Armies gather in the dark forests and along the mountain passes. Torches flicker at night where no travelers should be. The border outposts send word of strange movements, of forces amassing in the cold.
related_events: King Magnus remains inconsolable one year after Snow White's mother's death
Dark forces gather on the kingdom's borders exploiting King Magnus's grief

name: Finn Questions Eric About the Wars
description: Finn asked Eric if he had fought in the west against the armies of the five kings. Eric nodded, his eyes on the forest ahead. Finn pressed him, asking about the death he must have seen. Eric replied that death was everywhere. When Finn insisted there was a difference between killing an animal and a man, and asked how many men Eric had killed, Eric said he hadn’t counted.
related_events: Finn questions Eric about his past combat experience
Eric responds to Finn's inquiry about death in battle
Eric states he did not count the men he killed

name: Finn Questions Eric About Killing
description: Finn rides beside Eric and asks if he fought in the west against the armies of the five kings. Eric nods, his eyes on the forest ahead. Finn presses him, asking about the death he must have seen, insisting there is a difference between killing an animal and a man. He asks how many men Eric has killed. Eric replies that he didn't count. Finn smiles and says he doesn't count either, but remembers every face, adding that there is no greater delight than battle. Eric does not respond, his expression unreadable. Finn continues, asking what Eric feels when he watches a man die. Eric answers, 'Sorrow.' Finn falls silent for a moment, then asks what the dying men feel at the tip of Eric's sword, saying he would like to know. Eric studies his face, then says, 'Too bad. You'll need one,' as they reach the edge of the Dark Forest and bring their horses to a halt.

After a moment, he asks what the dying men themselves feel at the moment of death, saying he would like to know. Eric studies Finn’s face, then turns his horse to a halt. The group stops at the edge of the Dark Forest. The guards do not speak. The horses shift uneasily. Mist rolls across the moors ahead.

Finn inquires about the dying men's final experiences

name: Eric Warns Finn of a Dark Path

name: The Group Halts at the Edge of the Dark Forest
description: Eric pulled his horse to a stop at the entrance of the Dark Forest, raising a hand to signal the group. The four guards stiffened in their saddles, their breath shallow, eyes fixed on the mist-shrouded trees. Finn sat straight, jaw tight, giving no outward sign of the unease pressing in. Around them, the horses snorted, ears flat, refusing to move forward, their hooves pawing at the earth as if sensing something beyond the veil of the treeline.

name: Snow White Retrieves the Roofing Nail
description: Snow White paces inside her cell when two magpies appear at the window, flapping their wings and drawing her attention. She watches them closely, then moves toward the window as they hop to the edge of the roof just outside. There, a loose roofing nail sits where the birds hover. She reaches through the bars, touches the nail, and works it back and forth until it begins to give. The magpies suddenly flutter away in alarm. Footsteps echo in the hall. Snow White yanks the nail free, jumps down, and lies on her bed just as the door unlocks and Finn steps inside.

Snow White loosens and retrieves a roofing nail from the window ledge
Magpies flee abruptly as footsteps approach

name: Snow White Hides the Nail and Feigns Passivity as Finn Enters
description: Snow White hears footsteps approaching and quickly conceals the roofing nail in her hand, lying still on her bed. Finn unlocks the cell door, steps inside, and stands silently, waiting. She remains motionless, her eyes slightly turning toward him, giving no sign of the weapon hidden in her grip.

name: Snow White and Finn's Tense Encounter
description: Snow White lies in her cell as Finn enters, leaving the key in the door. He asks if he woke her, and she replies hoarsely that he didn’t. She tells him she is always awake when he watches her. Finn steps closer, touching her arm, and says she will never be locked in a cell again. She says she is afraid of the Queen, and he replies, 'Not of me.' His hand moves from her hair to her cheek, then to her chest, while his other hand reaches for his dagger.

Finn touches Snow White's arm and reassures her

name: Finn Reaches for His Dagger and Snow White Fights Back
description: Finn strokes Snow White's face, his hand moving from her hair to her cheek and then toward her chest. With his other hand, he reaches for his dagger. As he leans closer, Snow White slashes him across the face with the roofing nail she has been holding. Blood sprays, and Finn cries out, clutching his face. Snow White kicks him and rushes past, running out the door and locking it behind her.

name: Snow White Escapes After Wounding Finn

name: Eric Confronts Broch in the Clearing
description: Eric stumbles through the trees, drunk, brushing past branches and crashing into some as he goes. He emerges into a clearing and sees Rose, a beautiful girl, struggling against Broch, a huge tattooed warrior. Broch looms over her, threatening violence. Eric steps forward and places a hand on Rose. Broch turns and sees him, a huntsman with a hatchet in hand. 'Ale given you courage again, huntsman?' Broch sneers. Eric narrows his eyes and replies, 'Won't take much courage to split your skull from here.' Broch grins and draws his axe, advancing toward Eric.

In an instant, Broch was on him, swinging the heavy axe in fierce blows. Eric, slowed by drink, dodged narrowly, his movements sharp but unsteady. The clash drove Eric back toward the trees, Broch pressing the attack until the blade of his axe bit deep into the trunk of an oak, where it stuck fast.

A dark smile crosses Eric's face as he draws his second hatchet. Instead of striking with the blade, he swings the handle, cracking Broch across the head and knocking him unconscious.

name: Eric Searches Broch and Takes Rose
description: After knocking Broch unconscious, Eric kneels and searches through his pockets. Rose steps forward and thanks him. Eric turns to her, gently lifts her chin, and studies her face. Rose smiles up at him, her expression soft and inviting. Without a word, Eric suddenly grabs her, swings her up, and tosses her over his shoulder. As he carries her away, he says, "Don't worry, somebody else will."

name: Eric Confronts Broch in a Drunken Brawl
description: Eric, visibly drunk, lies on the ground as Broch steps through a broken wall and looms over him, demanding money he owes from his pocket and for the girl. Eric reaches out a hand, claiming he has the payment in his pocket and asking for help to stand. Broch approaches cautiously. As Broch draws near, Eric grabs his arm and kicks him hard in the chest, sending him backward. Broch quickly recovers, strides forward, and kicks Eric in the side, causing him to wince in pain. Still on the ground, Eric mumbles that he seems to have drunk all the money and offers it back when it comes out again. Broch hauls Eric to his feet. He throws a punch, but Eric, despite his intoxication, dodges it and swings back, landing a solid blow to Broch's body. Broch doubles over. Eric pulls back for another strike, but misses Broch entirely and instead hits a nearby horse on the rump. The horse kicks out, launching Eric into the air. He lands in a heap, his head dropping back. Several hands grab him, lift him briefly, and then dump him into a horse trough. He remains submerged for a few seconds before surfacing, eyes still closed, muttering about perfume. He opens his eyes to see Finn looking down at him. Finn says the Queen demands his presence. Eric replies that he's in the middle of a bath.

He sinks beneath the surface and remains underwater for several seconds, still and unresponsive. Slowly, he begins to stir, lifting his head out of the water, eyes closed, dripping and dazed.

name: Ravenna Confronts the Captured Rebels
description: Ravenna strides into the great hall where Generals and Finn stand at attention. Two captured insurgents, Thomas and his son Lain, are held by guards. Thomas is bruised and battered, while Lain remains unharmed. A soldier steps forward and reports that the two led an ambush on a royal supply caravan. Ravenna approaches them, demanding to know why they would abandon her protection to join the rebellion. Thomas declares that under her rule they have lost everything and will fight until the kingdom is free. Ravenna turns to Lain, commenting on his handsomeness, and touches his jaw. Lain suddenly seizes a guard’s dagger and stabs her in the chest. Ravenna shows no injury, pulls the dagger out, and drops it. She praises his courage, then places her hand on his chest. His heartbeat grows louder and more violent until it stops—he collapses, dead. Thomas falls to his knees in anguish, trying to revive his son. Finn draws his sword to execute Thomas, but Ravenna stops him, ordering that the man be released to carry word of her mercy. She turns and leaves the hall, followed by Finn. As she walks, she falters slightly. Finn offers support, but she pulls away. The others quickly exit at her command. Alone with Finn, she admits her strength is fading. He brings her a young woman, Rose. Ravenna grips Rose by the throat, lifts her off the ground, and drains a stream of energy from her. Youth and beauty flow into Ravenna, erasing her age lines, while Rose withers into an old woman before collapsing.

name: Ravenna Confronts the Rebel Son
description: Ravenna enters the great hall where two captured insurgents, Thomas and his son Lain, are held. She questions Thomas about his rebellion, then turns her attention to Lain, remarking on his handsomeness. As she touches his face, Lain seizes a guard’s dagger and stabs her in the chest. Ravenna shows no injury, removes the dagger, and drops it to the floor. She praises his courage, then places her hand on his chest. His heartbeat grows louder and more violent until it stops, and he collapses, dead. Thomas falls to his knees in despair. Finn moves to execute him, but Ravenna orders the man released to carry word of her mercy. She departs, faltering slightly, and retreats to the mirror chamber.

name: Ravenna's Decline and Restoration
description: After confronting the captured rebels, Ravenna stumbles, gripping the wall for support. Finn reaches for her arm, but she pulls away sharply. She orders the others to leave, allowing only Finn to remain. Leaning against the stone, she admits her powers are fading. Without another word, she ascends to the mirror chamber. Inside, she stands before the mirror, hesitating, her face lined with fatigue. Finn enters behind her, leading Rose. Ravenna studies the girl, then seizes her by the throat, lifting her off the ground. Rose’s mouth opens in a silent scream as a stream of glowing energy pours out. Ravenna inhales the light, her skin smoothing, her youth returning. Rose withers rapidly, her hair turning white, her body shrinking into old age. When it is over, Ravenna stands renewed, her reflection restored, while Rose collapses, frail and broken.

name: Ravenna Seduces and Kills King Magnus
description: Ravenna stands near the fireplace in a sheer silk nightgown, holding a goblet, her eyes locked on King Magnus, who lies on the bed, drunk and entranced. He asks her who she is, licking his lips as she slowly approaches. She climbs onto the bed, rolls him onto his back, and straddles him, offering the goblet. He drinks deeply, tosses the goblet aside, and grabs her body. She declares he is now hers. When he tries to push her off playfully, she seizes his hands and pins them down with unexpected strength. She kisses him after ripping open his shirt, then speaks of her people and family being destroyed. Confusion crosses his face. He begins to choke, his eyes widening. She tells him she will take his life, then his throne. Reaching beneath the sheets, she pulls out an ornate dagger and drives it into him.

name: Eric Confronts Ravenna in the Throne Room
description: Eric stumbles into the throne room, his clothes damp and filthy, his face bruised, reeling from drink. Ravens perch along the stone ledges, watching as he moves through the chamber. The scullery maids, hunched and aged, stare at him with sharp, accusing eyes—Rose among them. He glances at them, confused, unsure why they regard him so. At the far end of the hall, Ravenna sits on her throne, observing him with quiet curiosity. He approaches her, sizing her up as though she were a woman he might meet in a tavern. Finn stands nearby, silent. Ravenna speaks first, saying her brother has told her of Eric’s past—his lost wife, his drinking, his journeys into the Dark Forest. She tells him one of her prisoners, a woman, has escaped there. Eric replies that if she went into the forest, she is certainly dead. Ravenna commands him to find her. He refuses, saying he will not return to that place. She offers a reward. He scoffs, saying coin is useless to a dead man. Ravenna descends from her throne and steps toward him, suggesting the reward might be more than gold. Eric asks why the woman’s life matters so much. Ravenna says it is not his concern. He insists he decides what concerns him. She moves closer, telling him he will do this for her. When he asks what happens if he refuses, she nods to the guards. They draw their swords, ready to strike. Eric looks at them, then back at her, and says, 'Do me the favor. I beg of you.' Ravenna replies that he might be reunited with his beloved. In a flash, Eric grabs her by the throat. The court rises in alarm. The guards tense, but Ravenna raises a hand, stopping them. Eric releases her, shaken. She offers her condolences and asks if he misses his wife. He does not speak, but his eyes answer. She asks what he would give to bring her back. He says nothing can. Ravenna steps close, tells him she has the power to do it—bring his wife back in exchange for bringing her the girl. A life for a life.

Eric glances at the birds, then at the queen, before noticing several aged scullery maids staring at him with accusation. He approaches Ravenna, who studies him with quiet curiosity. She speaks of his reputation—widower, drunkard, and one of the few who has survived the Dark Forest. Finn stands nearby, silent. Ravenna reveals that a female prisoner has escaped into the forest and demands Eric bring her back. Eric replies that anyone who enters the forest dies, and he will not return. He questions why the woman’s life matters so much, but Ravenna dismisses his inquiry. When he refuses again, citing the futility of coin if he is dead, Ravenna suggests the reward may be more than gold. She steps down from her throne and moves toward him, hinting at the return of his wife. Eric grabs her by the throat, but releases her when the guards react. Ravenna expresses mock condolences and asks if he misses his wife. Eric does not answer, but his eyes betray his grief. Ravenna promises to bring his wife back in exchange for retrieving the prisoner. Eric insists nothing can restore the dead. Ravenna steps closer, insisting she can, and offers a life for a life.
